gpu_memory.reason: CPU CLI run; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES is empty; no NVML process monitor was run. No zero-memory claim.

cautions: Single sequential measurements on a shared host; not an AB/BA repeated statistical estimate.
Different driver implementations wrap the same subprocess invocation. API total_seconds scope differs slightly; headline only uses the two outer subprocess command timers.
Nested surface timings are already included in parent top-level stages and must not be added to whole time.
topology_python_seconds includes remesh and intersection and is not an independent additional hotspot.
Native placement algorithm and program hashes were not changed. Their measured slowdowns are not attributed to the new NumPy/Numba changes without a fresh native profile and paired rerun.
RH remesh whole-run duration increased despite faster frozen-input regressions; host scheduling, JIT/cache and input propagation require diagnosis.
No official reference speed ratio inferred from this FNIT before/after pair.
No GPU memory measurement was made for this CPU case.
Strict reproduction and whole metric equivalence are evaluated separately by comparison reports; this timing report makes no equivalence claim.
